screening_decisions.reason: Not a randomized controlled trial; a retrospective analysis of consecutive abortion cases without comparison of different surgical methods.
RCT randomizing women to manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) vs conventional electric vacuum aspiration, directly comparing two surgical methods for first trimester abortion.
Not an RCT; a trends analysis comparing mortality pre/post Roe v Wade, not a comparison of different surgical methods.
RCT but compares prostaglandin cervical preparation vs placebo before vacuum aspiration, not different surgical methods. The surgical procedure was the same, so it does not compare surgical methods.
RCT directly comparing dilatation and curettage (D&C) vs vacuum aspiration, two different surgical methods for first trimester abortion.
RCT comparing manual vacuum aspiration vs electric vacuum aspiration, two different surgical methods; acceptability is a valid outcome.
RCT assigning women to MVA vs EVA for first trimester abortion; compares two surgical methods, with perception/acceptability as outcomes.
No mention of randomization; appears to be a non-randomized comparison of vacuum aspiration vs D&C in a small sample. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing metal vs flexible plastic cannulae for vacuum aspiration, a comparison of two different surgical instruments/methods.
RCT comparing manual vacuum aspirator vs electric vacuum curettage, two different surgical methods for first trimester abortion.
